```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# loading in data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))
head(sal)
```

```{r}
sal$experience_level <- factor(
  sal$experience_level,
  levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
  labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
)
sal <- sal |> 
  mutate(
    remote = case_when(
      remote_ratio == 0 ~ "On-Site",
      remote_ratio == 50 ~ "Hybrid",
      remote_ratio == 100 ~ "Fully remote"
    ), 
    remote = factor(
      remote, levels = c("On-Site", "Hybrid", "Fully remote")
    )
  )
sal <- sal |> 
  filter(employment_type == "FT") |> mutate(log_salary = log(salary_in_usd))

```

```{r}
sal <- sal |>
  mutate(
    role_group = case_when(

      # Data Science
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data scientist|decision scientist|applied scientist"
      ) ~ "Data Science",

      # AI / Machine Learning
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "machine learning|\\bml\\b|artificial intelligence|\\bai\\b|nlp|computer vision|deep learning|llm|prompt"
      ) ~ "AI / Machine Learning",

      # Data Engineering / Infrastructure
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "data engineer|data architect|dataops|data infrastructure|data platform|data integration|etl|data pipeline|data developer"
      ) ~ "Data Engineering / Infrastructure",

      # Analytics / BI
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "analyst|analytics|business intelligence|\\bbi\\b|power bi|data analysis|reporting|data visualization"
      ) ~ "Analytics / BI",

      # Research / Quantitative
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "research|quantitative|statistician|statistical|computational scientist|economist|actuar|postdoctoral"
      ) ~ "Research / Quantitative",

      # Management / Product
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "manager|director|head of|product manager|product owner|data lead|analytics lead"
      ) ~ "Management / Product",

      # Software / Systems Engineering
      str_detect(
        str_to_lower(job_title),
        "software|developer|engineer|devops|platform|site reliability|systems|system engineer|architect|technical lead|tech lead"
      ) ~ "Software / Systems Engineering",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )
sal |>
  count(role_group, sort = TRUE)

```
```{r}

n <- nrow(sal)

train_index <- sample(
  1:n,
  size = 0.8 * n
)

train <- sal[train_index, ]
test  <- sal[-train_index, ]

salary_model_train <- lm(
  log(salary_in_usd) ~ experience_level +
    company_size +
    factor(work_year) +
    remote_ratio +
    role_group,
  data = sal
)

test$pred_log_salary <- predict(
  salary_model_train,
  newdata = test
)

summary(salary_model_train)

test$pred_salary <- exp(test$pred_log_salary)

mean(abs(
  test$salary_in_usd - test$pred_salary
))
```

```{r}
sal |>
  ggplot(aes(x = role_group, y = log(salary_in_usd))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Salary Distribution by Role Group",
    x = "Role Group",
    y = "Log Salary"
  )
sal |>
  group_by(role_group) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_salary = median(salary_in_usd),
    mean_salary = mean(salary_in_usd),
    sd_salary = sd(salary_in_usd),
    IQR_salary = IQR(salary_in_usd)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(median_salary))

sal |>
  group_by(role_group) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_log_salary = median(log(salary_in_usd)),
    sd_log_salary = sd(log(salary_in_usd)),
    IQR_log_salary = IQR(log(salary_in_usd))
  )
```
